# raggame — Project Context

This file is the authoritative map of the repository for AI assistants. Read this instead of re-exploring the codebase.

## What this project is

**RAGame** is a 3D first-person detective game (Godot 4.7) where the player interrogates NPCs by typing free-form Spanish text. NPC replies are generated by a local LLM (Ollama) behind a FastAPI backend and streamed token-by-token into a chat UI. The current case ("Un crimen casi perfecto", based on Roberto Arlt's short story): Mrs. Stevens was poisoned with cyanide in her whisky; the suspects are Esteban, Juan and Pablo.

Despite the name, there is **no RAG/retrieval yet**: no embeddings, no vector store. NPCs are persona-prompted; clue detection is keyword matching in GDScript. "RAG" is the planned direction.

## Current gameplay flow (as wired today)

```
menu_inicio.tscn  ← MAIN SCENE (project.godot) — title screen ("EL DEPARTAMENTO"),
                    Jugar → mapa_menu.tscn, Salir → quit; plays ambience audio +
                    vignette/grain/flicker shader overlay
  → mapa_menu.tscn — 3D level-select hub ("tablon" floor): click building models
                    (group nodo_mapa) to enter a scene:
                      comisaria → comisaria.tscn (police station)
                      laboratorio → laboratorio.tscn (Pablo's lab, playable)
                      departamento → Hall.tscn (building hall w/ Esteban,Juan,Criada)
                      oficina → ⚠️ points to "res://scenes/oficina.gd" (no .tscn → broken)
  → comisaria.tscn — includes a pizarron (board). Clicking it opens:
  → reconocimiento.tscn — lineup / "rueda": pick a suspect (group sospechoso) → confirm →
  → veredicto.tscn — typewriter text ending based on Global.accused_id
```

`campo.tscn` (outdoor field + generic Aldric NPC + old DialogueUI) still exists but is only a **dev/test playground** — it is no longer the main scene.

## Architecture / data flow

```
Player types text (DialogueUI LineEdit)
  → jugador.gd _on_text_submitted()
      1. EventManager.check_input(text)        # local keyword → clue activation
      2. nearby_npc.request_response(text)
          → npc.gd streams POST http://127.0.0.1:8000/dialogue_stream
              → backend/main.py builds messages [persona system + history + input]
                  → POST http://localhost:11434/api/chat (Ollama, qwen2.5:1.5b)
              ← streams plain-text chunks back
          ← emits response_chunk(text) ... response_completed
  ← DialogueUI appends chunks live into RichTextLabel history
```

## Backend (backend/main.py)

- `POST /dialogue_stream` — body `{npc_id, player_input, session_id="default"}`. Returns `StreamingResponse` of raw text chunks (not SSE). On unknown npc_id → 404.
- Personas hardcoded in `NPC_PERSONAS` dict (main.py:14): **Aldric** (blacksmith, leftover demo NPC), **Esteban**, **Juan**, **Criada**, **Pablo**, **Forense** (the real cast). Each prompt enforces: always Spanish, first person, 2–4 sentences (Juan shorter), never break character, admit ignorance instead of inventing.
- Conversation memory: `HISTORIES` defaultdict keyed `(session_id, npc_id)`, in RAM only, last `MAX_HISTORY = 20` messages sent to model. No persistence anywhere.
- Ollama call options: `num_predict: 200`, `temperature: 0.8`, `think: false`.
- Run: `uvicorn main:app --port 8000` (game hardcodes host 127.0.0.1 port 8000). Requires Ollama serving qwen2.5:1.5b on 11434.
- `requirements.txt` pins fastapi 0.136, pydantic 2.13, uvicorn 0.49, requests 2.34.

## Game side

### Autoloads (project.godot [autoload])

- **Global** (`game/scenes/global.gd`) — the ONLY autoload registered. Stub `Node` holding `accused_id: String` and `accused_name: String`, set by reconocimiento.gd and read by veredicto.gd.
- ⚠️ **EventManager and InputManager are NOT registered as autoloads** even though jugador.gd and dialogue_ui.gd reference them as globals (`EventManager.check_input()`, `InputManager.using_controller`). This is a **live regression**: the dialogue/examine/controller flow is currently broken at runtime. The scripts themselves (scripts/systems/event_manager.gd, input_manager.gd) are intact and typed as if autoloaded — they just need to be re-added to `[autoload]` (or handled otherwise).

### Systems scripts (in scripts/systems/, currently unregistered)

- **event_manager.gd** — global clue state. `activated_events: Dictionary`, signal `event_activated(event_id)`, `activate_event(id)` idempotent, `has_event(id)`, `reset_events()`, `check_input(text) -> bool` lowercases input and substring-matches against `keyword_events`. Currently ONE clue: `"poliza de seguro"/"póliza de seguro"/"seguro de vida"/"póliza"` → `"poliza_de_seguro"` (event_manager.gd:74).
- **input_manager.gd** — tracks last input device (keyboard/mouse vs joypad). `using_controller: bool`, signal `device_changed`, `action_glyph(action="interact") -> "[E]"/"(A)"`, `cancel_glyph() -> "[Esc]"/"(B)"`, Xbox button names via `XBOX_BUTTON_NAMES`.

### Input map (project.godot)

| Action | Keyboard | Controller |
|---|---|---|
| `interact` | E | A (button 0) |
| `examine` | F | X (button 2) |

`ui_cancel` is the built-in action (Esc, and B/cancel on joypad by default). Movement uses built-in `ui_left/right/up/down`. Physics: Jolt. Default GUI font: `fonts/VCR_OSD_MONO_1.001.ttf` via `fonts/theme_horror.tres`.

### Core scripts

- **jugador.gd** (scenes/jugador.gd) — `CharacterBody3D` player. Movement + walk anim ("mixamo_com"), rotates toward move dir. Freezes during dialogue (`in_dialogue`). Raycast every frame (`_process`) for group `examinable`/`pizarron` (collision **mask 2**, max distance `EXAMINE_DISTANCE = 3.0`); with controller the ray goes through screen center, otherwise mouse position. Handles: open/close dialogue, examine object, left-click (clicks `pizarron` → `interact()` which opens the lineup; else `_examine_object`), route submitted text to EventManager + NPC streaming. Prompt priority: examinable/pizarron > NPC > hidden.
- **npc.gd** (scenes/npc.gd + scenes/npcs/*.tscn) — `Node3D` base NPC. Exports `npc_id`, `npc_name`, `clothes_texture` (applied to first found MeshInstance3D material). Area3D `$InteractionArea` emits `player_entered_range/exited_range` when the player enters. `_ready()` builds a StaticBody3D + CapsuleShape3D child (r=0.35, h=3.2 local — models ~3.2u tall natively) so the player collides with NPCs. Streaming via raw `HTTPClient` (poll-per-frame loop, reads chunks, emits `response_chunk`/`response_completed`), guarded by `is_streaming`. Backend constants at npc.gd:28-30. NPC scenes: esteban.tscn (Character_27_HM, green tint), juan.tscn (Character_29, blue), pablo.tscn (Character_25_Doctor, blue), criada.tscn (Character_29_Female, pink), forense.tscn (Character_26_Doctor, no tint).
- **DialogueUI** — the scene `jugador.tscn` now wires the lowercase **`dialogue_ui.gd`** (178 lines, NEWER). It integrates InputManager, `show_prompt(target_name, verb, action)` with dynamic glyphs, updates placeholder/prompt on device change; player color #88ccff, NPC color #ffe080. The old capitalized **`DialogueUI.gd`/`DialogueUI.tscn`** still exist but are only used by `campo.tscn` (dev playground) — the previous live signature mismatch is **resolved** for the playable scenes.
- **Examinable objects** pattern (see copa.gd): extends StaticBody3D, joins group `examinable` (collision_layer=2 in copa.tscn), exports `description` (@export_multiline) + `object_name`; methods `highlight()/unhighlight()` (emission overlay material), `get_description()`. Examples: copa.tscn (whisky glass, on layer 2), victima.tscn (uses assets/Characters_psx/Models/Female/dying_(1).gd).
- **Map hub nodes** pattern (departamento.gd, comisaria.gd, laboratorio.gd, oficina.gd): StaticBody3D in group `nodo_mapa`, slow auto-rotation, highlight/unhighlight, exports `location_name` + `scene_path` (@export_file .tscn) + `get_scene_path()`. ⚠️ `laboratorio.gd` and `oficina.gd` have default `scene_path` pointing at `.gd` files (not `.tscn`), and `laboratorio.gd` duplicates `get_scene_path()`. The mapa_menu override fixes laboratorio to `laboratorio.tscn`; oficina is broken.
- **mapa_menu.gd** (scenes/mapa_menu.gd) — 3D level-select hub: mouse raycast over `nodo_mapa` nodes highlights them; left click calls `change_scene_to_file(node.get_scene_path())`.
- **menu_inicio.gd** (game/menu_inicio.gd + scenes/menu_inicio.tscn) — main scene. Title "EL DEPARTAMENTO" (placeholder), subtitle "un caso sin resolver", Jugar/Salir buttons, loops the ambience wav, and a canvas_item vignette + film grain + flicker shader overlay. `ESCENA_INICIAL = res://scenes/mapa_menu.tscn`.
- **reconocimiento.gd + hermano_abogado.gd** (lineup prototype, WIP) — reconocimiento.gd is a node script: mouse raycast over group `sospechoso`, click to show a confirm panel, "Sí, acusar" sets `Global.accused_id/name` then changes to veredicto.tscn; Esc/Esc cancels. hermano_abogado.gd extends StaticBody3D, joins `sospechoso`, exports `suspect_name`/`suspect_id`, highlight/unhighlight. ⚠️ reconocimiento.tscn has one wired suspect (`hermano_abogado`, defaults Aldric) plus a second figure (Character_26_Doctor) with **no** suspect script — incomplete.
- **veredicto.gd + veredicto.tscn** — reads `Global.accused_id`, typewriter TextLabel. `finales` dict keyed by suspect id with `CULPABLE_REAL = "mira"`; endings exist for `aldric`, `mira`, `herve`. ⚠️ These suspect ids (mira/hervé/aldric) do **not** match the crime story's cast (Esteban/Juan/Pablo) — an earlier/alternate prototype.
- **pizarron.gd** (scenes/pizarron.gd, used by comisaria.tscn) — StaticBody3D in group `pizarron`, highlight/unhighlight, `interact()` → change_scene_to_file("res://scenes/reconocimiento.tscn"). The pizarron node in comisaria.tscn is on collision_layer 2 so the examine ray hits it.

### Scenes

- `menu_inicio.tscn` — **main scene** (title screen, script-only node).
- `mapa_menu.tscn` — hub with rotating building models wired to comisaria/laboratorio/oficina/departamento scripts.
- `comisaria.tscn` — furnished police station: desks w/ computers, printer, clock, cork message board, and the `pizarron` (lineup trigger) on layer 2. Player only (no NPCs).
- `laboratorio.tscn` — Pablo's forensic lab (playable): counter tables, bunsen, scale, hot plate, microscopes, CRT desk workstation, fire extinguisher, ring stand, beakers (flask scale ≈ tiny; assets natively huge). Note the playable lab is a different thing from the `laboratorio.gd` hub-model script.
- `Hall.tscn` — building hall; instances jugador + criada, esteban, juan. ⚠️ Contains a legacy `AreaLight3D` node (a non-existent type) under `Carpet_1` that Godot drops on load — the hall still works but that light is missing.
- `dpto.tscn` — crime scene apartment: wood floor, kitchen/bathroom, tv/couch, crime-scene markers; instances jugador + forense + victima.tscn + copa.tscn.
- `campo.tscn` — outdoor dev/test field with trees; instances jugador + generic npc.tscn (Aldric) + old DialogueUI.tscn. Not the main scene.
- `elevador.tscn` — empty shell, elevator GLB only, no script/player.
- `reconocimiento.tscn` — lineup scene (WIP, see above). `veredicto.tscn` — verdict screen (WIP, see above).

### Groups used

- `player` (jugador), `npc` (npc.gd), `examinable` (interactable objects), `nodo_mapa` (hub location models), `sospechoso` (hermano_abogado lineup figures), `pizarron` (pizarron.gd lineup trigger).

## Story / design docs

`game/assets/crimen-casi-perfecto-scripts/`:
- `BS.-Un-crimen-casi-perfcto.-Arlt-.pdf` — source material (Roberto Arlt).
- `paso-a-paso-juego.md` — clue list per suspect: Esteban took out the life insurance 3 months ago and benefits financially; Juan is an ex-con sociopath (7 years for dealing, blames Mrs. Stevens) and now inherits; Pablo has close ties, fixed the fridge, and has cyanide at work; the criada made the whisky and was abused by Mrs. Stevens. Happy path notes the poison (fast-metabolizing chemical) wasn't found in glasses/bottles.
- `guiones/*.md` — per-character interview scripts (criada, esteban, juan, pablo, quimico, tecnico_heladera, portero).

## Conventions

- Language: all comments, strings, prompts and docs in **Spanish (Rioplatense / voseo)** — "Vos", "tenés", "Escribí". Keep it that way.
- Godot: tabs indentation; UI constructed programmatically rather than in .tscn where dynamic; signals over polling; `@export` for designer-facing vars.
- Backend: minimal single-file FastAPI; pydantic models for request/response; no auth (local dev only).
- Comments in code are verbose teaching-style blocks (the author uses them to learn); match that style when editing existing files.

## Current state, gaps & known issues

1. No actual RAG: retrieval/embeddings/vector DB not implemented; personas are static prompts.
2. **EventManager and InputManager are no longer registered as autoloads** though jugador.gd / dialogue_ui.gd depend on them as globals — the dialogue + examine + controller flow is currently broken at runtime. Only `Global` is autoloaded.
3. Keyword clue detection covers a single clue (`poliza_de_seguro`); comment in event_manager.gd says an LLM hook is planned. `data/events/events.gd` and `scripts/systems/pistas.md` are empty placeholders awaiting a proper clue catalog.
4. The lineup/verdict prototype (`reconocimiento`/`veredicto`/`hermano_abogado`) is incomplete and inconsistent with the actual crime story: suspect ids are `aldric`/`mira`/`herve` (culprit `mira`) while the real cast is Esteban/Juan/Pablo; reconocimiento.tscn's second lineup figure has no suspect script.
5. `oficina` hub node points to a non-existent `scenes/oficina.gd` path (no oficina.tscn); `laboratorio.gd`/`oficina.gd` default `scene_path`s point at `.gd` files, and `laboratorio.gd` has a duplicated `get_scene_path()`.
6. Backend memory is RAM-only and unbounded per session; server restart wipes conversations. Session id is hardcoded `"default"` from npc.gd.
7. Aldric persona exists in backend but only used by the generic npc.tscn in campo.tscn (dev playground).
8. Stray temp file `game/scenes/jugador.tscn102336247.tmp` should be deleted.
9. README.md contains only the title.
10. Examine raycast ignores areas (`collide_with_areas=false`), mask 2 only; objects must have collision on layer 2.
11. `Hall.tscn` references nonexistent `AreaLight3D` — Godot drops that light on load (scene still works, just a missing light). Should be replaced with OmniLight3D.
12. The main scene moved from `campo.tscn` to `menu_inicio.tscn`; engine version shows `4.7` (AGENTS.md and some assets still say 4.6). `game/assets/` holds many external asset packs (ZIPs and extracted folders, PSX-style and Lab Assets).
13. Git history: monorepo restructure moved everything under `game/` and `backend/`; later commits added the title/menu flow, lineup/verdict prototype, EventManager keyword detection, and controller support.
